{{Quote|I'm proud of earning my position, but a great Moff must be selfless--we live and die for the Sith.|Moff Phennir|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
'''Phennir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:CtA" />

Phennir oversaw an operation ordered by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] to capture the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], an ancient space station from the reign of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] that produced legions of battle droids. Phennir and his flagship, the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']], first captured a Republic warship, the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'', with the authorization codes to approach the Foundry, then sent an elite strike team to [[Battle of the Foundry|take the Foundry itself]] and defeat its master, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="TOR:CtA" />

During the [[Battle of Ilum]], Phennir was a member of an emergency war council called by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]] when Malgus declared his "[[New Empire]]." Phennir was outraged when he realized that Malgus had played him, as the renegade Sith Lord had incorporated the Foundry's technologies into his [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]].<ref name="TOR:CtA" />
